Class ConservativeRasterResampler

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.ConservativeRasterResampler
public final class ConservativeRasterResampler extends Object

ConservativeRasterResampler

State-of-the-art spherical equirectangular GIS regridding engine implementing first-order area-conservative overlap integration for extensive fields (population counts, agricultural land-use areas) and spherical-area-weighted conservative averaging (with NoData masking) for intensive continuous geophysical fields (elevation, temperature, precipitation, seasonality).

Mathematical Formulations

  • Spherical pixel solid-angle area on a sphere of IUGG mean radius $R_\oplus = 6371.0088\,\text{km}$: $$A_{\text{px}}(y) = \frac{2\pi}{W}\, R_\oplus^2 \big(\sin\phi_+(y) - \sin\phi_-(y)\big)$$
  • Exact conservative transfer fraction of source cell $(r,c)$ into target pixel $(y,x)$: $$\omega_{r,c \to y,x} = f_\lambda(x,c) \cdot \frac{\max\big(0,\, \min(\sin\phi_r^+, \sin\Phi_y^+) - \max(\sin\phi_r^-, \sin\Phi_y^-)\big)}{\sin\phi_r^+ - \sin\phi_r^-}$$ satisfying $\sum_{y,x} \omega_{r,c \to y,x} \equiv 1$ identically, guaranteeing exact global mass/count conservation without peak-blending bias or high-latitude area distortion.
  • Intensive area-weighted aggregation with valid-mask preservation: $$\bar{q}_{y,x} = \frac{\sum_{(r,c)\in\mathcal{V}} q_{r,c}\,\Omega_{y,x;r,c}}{\sum_{(r,c)\in\mathcal{V}} \Omega_{y,x;r,c}}$$ where $\Omega_{y,x;r,c} = f_\lambda(x,c)\cdot\Delta(\sin\phi)_{y,r}$ is the exact intersecting spherical solid angle and $\mathcal{V}$ excludes NoData/ocean masks.

    • sphericalPixelAreaKm2

      public static double sphericalPixelAreaKm2(int y, int width, int height)
      Computes the exact spherical surface area in $\text{km}^2$ of a single equirectangular pixel at row y in a global $[-180^\circ, 180^\circ] \times [-90^\circ, 90^\circ]$ grid indexed top-down ($y=0$ at $+90^\circ\text{N}$).
      Parameters:
      y - pixel row index in $[0, \text{height}-1]$
      width - grid width in pixels
      height - grid height in pixels
      Returns:
      exact spherical quadrangle area in $\text{km}^2$

    • resampleExtensive

      public static float[][] resampleExtensive(float[][] src, int srcW, int srcH, float nodata, int dstW, int dstH)
      Resamples an extensive global grid (counts or physical areas per source cell) onto a target equirectangular grid with exact global mass conservation via first-order spherical box overlap.
      Parameters:
      src - source array indexed [srcH][srcW] top-down (north-to-south)
      srcW - source column count
      srcH - source row count
      nodata - source NoData sentinel (cells <= 0 or matching nodata are ignored)
      dstW - target width
      dstH - target height
      Returns:
      conservatively regridded array [dstH][dstW] preserving $\sum \text{dst} \equiv \sum \text{src}$

    • resampleIntensiveMasked

      public static float[][] resampleIntensiveMasked(float[][] src, int srcW, int srcH, int dstW, int dstH, ConservativeRasterResampler.FloatValidityPredicate validity, float fallbackValue)
      Resamples an intensive continuous global grid (temperature, precipitation, seasonality, elevation) using spherical-area-weighted box-overlap averaging, masking out invalid/ocean cells so NoData values do not bleed across coastal boundaries.
      Parameters:
      src - source grid indexed [srcH][srcW]
      srcW - source width
      srcH - source height
      dstW - target width
      dstH - target height
      validity - validity predicate identifying physical values vs NoData sentinels
      fallbackValue - fallback value assigned when a target pixel has zero valid source overlap (pass Float.NaN to detect oceanic/unmapped pixels downstream)
      Returns:
      conservatively averaged array [dstH][dstW]
